class.name: GaussianSplatWorld3D
class.brief_description: Scene node that renders a GaussianSplatWorld resource as a merged multi-asset scene.
class.description: GaussianSplatWorld3D renders an entire GaussianSplatWorld resource containing multiple merged splat datasets as a single unified scene. It manages its own GaussianSplatRenderer instance, handles GPU resource lifecycle, and supports quality settings parity with GaussianSplatNode3D. Use [method apply_world] to load and display the world data, or enable [member auto_apply_on_ready] for automatic initialization. GaussianSplatWorld resources are authored in world space, so this node's global transform is expected to stay at identity; it is checked once when the world data is applied, not tracked live. A non-identity transform silently misplaces the rendered splats relative to the node's own bounds and triggers a one-time warning (or, with the project setting [code]rendering/gaussian_splatting/world/strict_identity_transform[/code] enabled, is rejected outright). Removing and re-adding this node to the scene tree (for example when reparenting) automatically restores a previously-applied world; [member auto_apply_on_ready] only governs whether the world is applied automatically the first time the node becomes ready.

method.name: get_region_id
method.description: Returns the region ID recorded under [param name] in the baked [code]regions[][/code] manifest, or -1 if unknown. Volume region IDs are NOT stable across edits. Game code must resolve regions by name with this method after loading or rebaking, never use a hard-coded numeric ID.

method.name: get_region_names
method.description: Returns region names from the baked manifest, in manifest order. Resolve each name through [method get_region_id]; volume IDs can change when volumes are added, removed, or renamed.

method.name: set_region_override
method.description: Assigns a runtime override to a baked region (0 to 65535). Resolve [param region] by name with [method get_region_id]. Region 0 supplies the whole-asset default; explicit regions replace that default. Updates made before rendering are uploaded before that frame's shadow and main passes and survive HLOD eviction. The override is specific to this node, including when several nodes share an asset.

method.name: clear_region_override
method.description: Clears this region's explicit override. It inherits the whole-asset default again.

method.name: clear_all_region_overrides
method.description: Clears all overrides, including the whole-asset default and the state set by [method set_hidden].

method.name: set_tint
method.description: Sets the whole-asset default tint and strength (clamped to 0 to 1). Strength 1 replaces the SH color with [param color]. Tint is applied after the SH cache and before lighting. Explicit region overrides replace this default.

method.name: set_emissive
method.description: Sets the whole-asset default emission, added after lighting. Components are clamped to 0 to 65504 during GPU upload. Explicit region overrides replace this default.

method.name: set_hidden
method.description: Hides every region, including explicit overrides, before sort records are allocated, and suppresses its shadows. This is distinct from [member Node3D.visible]: the instance remains registered. Passing false restores the authored per-region opacity and overrides.

method.name: create_island_nodes
method.description: Loads the assigned world's [code]islands[][/code] manifest and creates one [GaussianSplatNode3D] per valid entry. Returns only newly created nodes, in manifest order. A [code]null[/code] [param parent] uses this world node. Each node has the island's exact name and its [code]rest_transform[/code] as a local transform relative to the chosen parent. The serialized transform is a row-major 3 by 3 basis followed by the three origin coordinates. B2 currently writes identity rest transforms and always writes plain v3 island assets (no V4 size threshold exists). Calls are idempotent for a given parent: an existing direct child with the same name, of any type, is left unchanged and is not returned, reloaded or duplicated. Duplicate names within the manifest reject every occurrence, including the first. Invalid entries, missing or unreadable assets create no node for that entry; other valid entries can still succeed. Inspect [method get_island_errors] after the call, since an empty return can mean either nothing new or a failure. Relative [code]asset_path[/code] values resolve from the world resource's file directory and require a world resource path. Absolute filesystem, [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are accepted, matching B2's output-directory convention. Paths containing a [code]..[/code] component are refused. Names must be valid node names; bounds and the twelve transform numbers must be finite and correctly typed, and bounds sizes must be nonnegative. Created nodes use the ordinary instance path and count against the instance tail and shared ledger. Their asset payload, including baked semantic words, is loaded synchronously. The parent owns their lifetime; scene ownership is not assigned automatically (use [method Node.set_owner] if saving them into a scene). Call on the main thread.

method.name: get_island_names
method.description: Returns names of structurally valid, uniquely named island entries in manifest order. Validates names, bounds, rest transforms and path resolution without reading assets or creating nodes. Asset existence and readability are checked by [method create_island_nodes]. Replaces the diagnostics returned by [method get_island_errors].

method.name: get_island_errors
method.description: Returns diagnostics from the most recent [method create_island_nodes] or [method get_island_names] call. Each entry failure includes its [code]islands[index][/code], name when available, and a reason: [code]island_entry_type[/code], [code]island_name[/code], [code]island_duplicate_name[/code], [code]island_bounds[/code], [code]island_rest_transform[/code], [code]island_asset_path[/code], [code]island_asset_path_escape[/code], [code]island_world_path_missing[/code], [code]island_asset_missing[/code], [code]island_asset_unreadable[/code] (including path and error code), or [code]island_parent_rejected[/code]. Whole-manifest failures use [code]island_world_missing[/code] or [code]island_manifest_type[/code]. A world without an islands manifest and a call that only finds existing children both produce no errors.

method.name: set_world
method.description: Assigns a GaussianSplatWorld resource containing the merged splat data to render. Call [method apply_world] after assignment to upload the data to the GPU.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Returns the currently assigned GaussianSplatWorld resource, or [code]null[/code] if none is set.

method.name: set_auto_apply_on_ready
method.description: When enabled, the world data is automatically applied and uploaded to the GPU when the node receives the READY notification.

method.name: is_auto_apply_on_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if automatic apply on ready is enabled.

method.name: set_cast_shadow
method.description: Enables or disables shadow casting from this world node.

method.name: is_cast_shadow
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if shadow casting is enabled.

method.name: set_lod_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables level-of-detail culling for the world's splats.

method.name: set_wind_mode
method.description: Sets [member wind_mode].

method.name: get_wind_mode
method.description: Returns [member wind_mode].

method.name: set_wind_intensity
method.description: Sets [member wind_intensity], clamping negative values to zero.

method.name: get_wind_intensity
method.description: Returns [member wind_intensity].

method.name: set_effectors_enabled
method.description: Sets [member effectors_enabled].

method.name: is_effectors_enabled
method.description: Returns [member effectors_enabled].

method.name: is_lod_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if LOD culling is enabled.

method.name: set_hlod_tau_px
method.description: Sets the experimental resident HLOD pixel threshold. Zero inherits the project threshold. Negative or nonfinite values are rejected without changing the previous value.

method.name: get_hlod_tau_px
method.description: Returns the HLOD threshold override, or zero to inherit.

method.name: set_lod_bias
method.description: Sets the LOD bias multiplier (0.1 to 4.0). Higher values keep more splats visible.

method.name: get_lod_bias
method.description: Returns the current LOD bias multiplier.

method.name: set_max_render_distance
method.description: Sets the maximum distance in meters at which splats are rendered.

method.name: get_max_render_distance
method.description: Returns the current maximum render distance in meters.

method.name: set_max_splat_count
method.description: Sets the maximum number of splats to render per frame.

method.name: get_max_splat_count
method.description: Returns the current maximum splat count.

method.name: set_use_frustum_culling
method.description: Enables or disables frustum culling for the world's splats.

method.name: is_frustum_culling_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if frustum culling is enabled.

method.name: set_async_upload_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables asynchronous GPU buffer uploads. When enabled, data is streamed to the GPU without blocking the main thread.

method.name: is_async_upload_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if asynchronous uploads are enabled.

method.name: set_opacity
method.description: Sets the global opacity for all splats in this world. Range is 0.0 to 1.0.

method.name: get_opacity
method.description: Returns the current opacity value.

method.name: apply_world
method.description: Loads the assigned GaussianSplatWorld resource into the renderer and uploads all splat data to the GPU. Must be called after [method set_world] unless [member auto_apply_on_ready] is enabled.

method.name: clear_world
method.description: Removes all splat data from the renderer and releases associated GPU resources.

method.name: get_renderer
method.description: Returns the internal GaussianSplatRenderer instance managed by this node.

members.member: The GaussianSplatWorld resource containing merged splat datasets to render.
When enabled, the world is automatically applied when the node enters the tree.
Enables shadow casting from this world node.

Controls how this world inherits project wind, including on the streamed HLOD route. The project setting [code]rendering/gaussian_splatting/animation/wind_enabled[/code] must also be enabled. [constant WIND_MODE_AUTO] uses baked weights only on splats with valid semantic data; legacy splats stay still. [constant WIND_MODE_ON] also opts legacy splats into the opacity stiffness heuristic. [constant WIND_MODE_OFF] disables wind even on semantic splats. Semantic content with no authored wind input has weight zero and stays still. The rest-position phase uses a smoothly interpolated 32-metre lattice in world XZ space. Wind has full weight through 64 metres from the camera, smoothly reaches zero at 128 metres, and fades from full weight at leaf height 0 to zero at HLOD height 4. These are explicit shader constants; instance rows without an HLOD level use height 0. Sphere effectors are controlled independently by [member effectors_enabled]. [GaussianSplatNode3D] instances keep their own wind modes independently of this property.

Nonnegative wind weight for this world's row. Multiplies project wind strength and the per-splat wind weight selected by [member wind_mode]. Zero disables wind displacement for this world. Does not change instance row weights.

Opts this world's row into position and opacity effects from world-scope scene sphere effectors, or the project sphere-effector fallback when no scene payload exists. Independent of [member wind_mode]. Disabled by default for legacy worlds without baked semantics. Instance rows retain their own effector masks and scope filters.

Pixel error threshold override for the HLOD cut. A world with an HLOD tree over a resident payload, or a version 4 paged package, takes the HLOD route by default, together with the [GaussianSplatNode3D] instances of the scene; [code]rendering/gaussian_splatting/lod/hlod_runtime_cut_enabled[/code] = [code]false[/code] opts out. Zero inherits [code]rendering/gaussian_splatting/lod/hlod_tau_px[/code] (provisional default 1). The effective threshold is multiplied by [member quality/lod_bias]. Requires an identity world transform, complete resident leaves and parents, and one supported perspective main view; unsupported contexts use canonical leaves. Admission limits and diagnostics describe this bounded experimental route, not a large-world capacity guarantee.

Maximum rendering distance in meters. While LOD is enabled, streamed world chunks whose bounds lie entirely beyond this distance divided by the LOD bias are neither loaded nor drawn. The limit is per chunk: the streamed-world route does not cull individual splats by distance, so a chunk that reaches inside the limit is drawn whole. Exception: predictive prefetch, which loads chunks around the camera's predicted position, measures the same limit from that position rather than from the camera. With LOD disabled or a value of [code]0[/code] there is no limit: streaming then discovers chunks up to the camera's far plane or 10,000 m, whichever is nearer.
Maximum number of splats rendered per frame.
Enables frustum culling of offscreen splats.

constants.constant: Default. Inherits enabled project wind per splat using its baked wind weight when semantic data is valid. Legacy splats have zero wind weight, so a world without semantic data stays still.
Inherits enabled project wind, using baked weights for semantic splats and the opacity stiffness heuristic for legacy splats. This does not force project wind on.
Disables wind for this world, including splats with valid semantic data. Sphere effector enablement remains independent.
